stemMd: Which research decision best follows the passage’s reasoning?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Call recovery certain whenever any seed is detected.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Classify every non-germinating sample as containing no viable seeds.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Report non-detection under one treatment separately from a conclusion of complete absence.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Discard above-ground observations once soil is sampled.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Count vegetative species only by their seed abundance.

explanationMd: A method’s detection limits should constrain the conclusion. Distinguishing a negative assay from universal absence applies the central evidential caution.

distractorRationale.b: This repeats the inference the passage cautions against.
distractorRationale.a: Detection does not establish the full recovery sequence.
distractorRationale.e: The passage notes that some rely on other reproduction.
